supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s describe and draw shapes in specific groups. Required Preparation CCSS Standards Addressing 3.G.A.1 3.OA.C.7 Lesson Timeline Warm-up 10 min Activity 1 20 min Activity 2 15 min Lesson Synthesis 10 min Cool-down 5 min Teacher Reflection Question
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Draw examples of quadrilaterals that are not rhombuses, rectangles, or squares. Understand that shapes can be in more than one category.
teachingSteps: Look for attributes named in the task: sides, angles, parallel sides.
Test each attribute even when a figure is rotated.
Justify or revise the classification with a labelled drawing.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Shape type depends on defining properties, not orientation or apparent size.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.targetRichV2Field: lesson-specific correction proposal; not the published canonical body
